about_the_game:
Jolly Junction

You amble along the halls of Nutcase inc. a long-abandoned children’s television studio. Only to uncover the true horrors that hid behind its closed doors. Navigate your surroundings and fight off the monsters that sent this place to closure. Try to piece together its horrific past, and discover the mystery of this once beloved studio. You only have to do one thing, destroy Jolly Junction’s notorious group of mascots, The Jolly Crew. It’s fairly straightforward as there’s only 6 of them… right?

Nutcase inc.

Nutcase inc. was once a household name. Setting a better example at creating media appropriate for children, than its long-abandoned underbelly ‘The Kids Corner’. 

As with most places, all good things must come to an end. Nutcase inc. closed its doors for good. Leaving its gang of notorious mascot characters inside of it, to die. 

After decades of watching the townsfolk disappear one by one, you take it into your own hands to venture deep into the infamous studio and destroy its evil inhabitants…

The Jolly Crew

The main cast of characters from the hit 80’s programme ‘Jolly Junction’. This particular group of characters ruled over the entertainment market for years. Until, they didn’t. Their colours faded, and so did the child-like wonder inside of them. And now it's up to you to get rid of them. They’re due for one last play-date. Despite their evil intent, playing is what they do best…

The Main Premise

You are hired by an anonymous individual to venture inside of the Nutcase inc. television studio and destroy its evil inhabitants. These cast of characters being the infamous Jolly Crew mascots from the 80’s phenomenon Jolly Junction.

Unaware of the dangers, you agree and willingly take the job on. Upon arrival, you see that maybe this place is more of a threat than it seemed. 

Explore the remains

Venture deep into the remains of the nation’s most infamous children’s television studio. Discover buried artifacts and kick up secrets of the past in your every footstep. Discover what has been left by the past, children and employees alike. Try to find out and piece together what truly happened at this place, and possibly put an end to it.

See what was once a whimsical place of joy, now turned rotten, cold and terrifying. 

Watch your back

No good job comes without its risks. In this case, you’re trapped inside of an eerily quiet building inhabited by The Jolly Crew. Once the stars of the hit television programme ‘Jolly Junction’, now known for their bloodthirsty and vicious intent. Each member resides inside of that very studio. This means you're trapped in there with them. Stay sharp, avoid following any echoing voices or footsteps, no matter how enticed you may be. It will not end well for you. If you hear someone or something coming towards you, just run.

Lights, Camera, Action

Complete tasks to progress further into the studio. Keep in mind, this place has been shut down for decades. This means some areas and items may not work as they should. That’s up to you to fix it. Restore power, unlock new areas but make sure you’re not being followed. 

Let’s see if you’re the finale we need, or just another useless prop…

Meet the Jolly Crew!

Nolly Nutcase - The Squirrel

Nolly Nutcase is the leader of the Jolly Crew and the face and heart of Nutcase Inc. Regarded as the “big bad” of Jolly Junction, he is infamous among those of Willow Creek. Residents describe him as the fastest, most violent, and most terrifying of them all. With short orange fur, long blood-stained claws, and a grin pulled straight from the deepest depths of your nightmares, Nolly is a true horror staple. And if that weren’t enough, his vast army of doppelgangers ensures one thing is certain. He’s not someone you'd ever want to mess with.

Bug-a-Bloo - The Bug

At one point Bloo was indeed the most terrible and hostile of the Jolly Crew. That was up until an altercation with a certain someone, who stripped him down to his head and torso. Leaving him immobile on a set of wheels. Despite his newfound disability, the Jolly Crew still value and cherish him as a long serving member of the Jolly Crew. Remember, just because Bloo seems to be a lifeless prop, doesn't mean he is one. He can still see, hear and talk just like the other Crewmates can. Meaning if he spots you he won’t do anything, but he will alert the others. Beware. 

Furball Funzo - The Mole

Funzo is, by far, the creepiest member of the Jolly Crew. He moves in complete silence and always seems to find an audience, whether one is meant to be there or not. With short legs and long arms, which is unusual for a mole, though he’s said to be magical, or so the stories go. Covered in long purple fur, has a brown flat cap and is missing an eyeball (you’ll never guess how that happened), Funzo was once a fan favourite among children. Parents, however, often complained that “Furball Funzo” felt disturbingly out of place beside the rest of the Jolly Crew.

Felicity Feline - The Cat

Felicity has slowly crept her way into the spotlight over the years. If you were to ask a resident of Willow Creek about her, they probably wouldn’t even remember her from the children’s programme. It’s since the studio shut down she really let herself become known. Slowly becoming more upfront and commanding of the Jolly Crew and steadily rising to becoming Nolly’s second in command. Felicity is boastful yet charming in every way possible. Long red fur and big sparkling eyes, what else could you ask for from such an already purrr-fect feline friend?

Neuton Nutjob -  The Space Squirrel

Neuton is typically the most forgettable of the Jolly Crew. He was designed to be an ‘Alien Nolly Nutcase’ which ties into his actual appearance and personality in the Jolly Junction children’s programme. His fur is bright green and yellow to really exaggerate the tone of an extra terrestrial-like being, alongside his glowing red eyes, lacking a pair of pupils. Neuton was noticeably the most threatening of the Crew, some even considering him a bigger scare than Nolly Nutcase himself. Where there’s Nolly, Neuton is never far behind. He’s quick, intelligent and deadly…

Toco Talons - The Toucan

Named after the species of bird 'Toco Toucan', Toco is the shy, quiet member of the Jolly Crew. The Crew always hunts as a pack. Not Toco, though. She usually lingers behind, staying out of trouble whenever she can. She was never given wings, like you'd expect a bird to have. When the costumes were made, the studio had ran out of fabric and didn’t care enough to supply more, leaving her wingless and brushing it off as a “unique design choice.” This unsurprisingly, makes her far more vulnerable than the rest of the Crew. Since the studio shut down, Toco has also lost her beak, coincidentally during the same incident that left Bug-a-Bloo without his arms…

You ready to meet the Crew? They're all super excited to meet you!

-PLAYER CONTROLS-

{W,A,S,D} - Player Movement

{SHIFT} - Sprint

{E} - Interact/Use Items

{ESCAPE} - Quit Experience





IMPORTANT: If any content creators/streamers would like to play the game for content a copyright claim MAY show up because we are unable to lift the copyright for the soundtrack. Not to worry, just get in touch at @jollyjunction.holystatic@gmail.com and we will individually grant permissions for the usage meaning the claim will be lifted. Sorry about the inconvenience but it is out of my hands as the developer.

content_descriptors.notes: Jolly Junction contains references to sensitive and potentially distressing topics. Players of the game should be aware that certain story elements, dialogue, or imagery may involve dark themes, unsettling content, or mature subject matter.
